title: Commit-specific explanations
responsibility: Selects reasons that explain a commit’s own first-parent changes rather than merely belonging to a longer verification range.

inputs.name: revisionReasons.sources
inputs.description: The first parent, readable own changes (or undefined when unreadable), notes, and intact records with each record’s verification base. Records whose base equals the parent are exact; longer-range entries do not establish this commit’s own change, though notes not held by longer records are retained when own changes are unavailable.

outputs.name: revisionReasons
outputs.description: Distinct explanations in stable canonical JSON order and the count of distinct held explanations not shown. Exact-base record entries are retained; when own changes are readable, other reasons must match a changed step, and otherwise notes duplicated by longer-range records are omitted.
